pt.home_title: Neto Vettorello — Murais, pintura e arte pública
pt.home_description: Artista visual brasileiro. Murais de grande escala, pinturas e esculturas enraizadas nas cosmologias afro-brasileiras e indígenas. Projetos no mundo todo.
pt.intro: Artista visual brasileiro. Murais de grande escala, pinturas e esculturas que levam as cosmologias afro-brasileiras e indígenas para o espaço público.
pt.murals_intro: Murais e arte pública para prefeituras, embaixadas, universidades, festivais e marcas.

en.home_title: Neto Vettorello — Murals, painting and public art
en.home_description: Brazilian visual artist. Large-scale murals, paintings and sculpture rooted in Afro-Brazilian and Indigenous cosmologies. Projects worldwide.
en.intro: Brazilian visual artist. Large-scale murals, paintings and sculpture that bring Afro-Brazilian and Indigenous cosmologies into public space.
en.murals_intro: Murals and public art for city councils, embassies, universities, festivals and brands.
en.works_intro: Mixed media paintings on canvas and sculpture. Available works can be acquired directly from the artist.
en.contact_text: Murals, artworks, exhibitions and brand collaborations. Tell me about your project and I’ll reply within 3 working days.
